name: Gina’s Revenge
description: Collect Cryptid Horns to hunt Cryptids and earn Gina shards.

phases.name: Find a Cryptid
phases.description: Use a Horn of the Cryptid from the Other tab of your backpack. You get horns as a chance reward for defeating beasts during the event. Hunt beasts on the Intel to save stamina.

phases.name: Rally
phases.description: Tap the rally button on the Cryptid. It costs 25 Chief Stamina, or 20 with Gina skills at level 5. Each rally gives 2 to 4 Gina shards. Finish 10 event rallies for a reward of 10 Gina shards, whether or not they succeed.

rewards.name: Gina Shard
rewards.note: 2 to 4 for each rally and 10 for finishing 10 rallies

tips: Recruit Gina early. With her in the march she cuts Chief Stamina costs by 10 percent, up to 20 percent at a higher rank.
Hunt Cryptids one by one with Gina in the rally, and get as many players as possible to join.
Join rallies from alliance members for up to 50 help rewards a day. Use Auto Join under Alliance, Wars.
From Generation 4, Hero’s Mission converts Horns and Scattered Parts into Gina shards.
